title: Re-engage a customer after an unanswered quote
scenario: Customer has not replied to a sent quote and has not booked. A friendly, no-pressure follow-up to reopen the conversation.
original:
Hi Sarah,

I hope you’re well. I just wanted to follow up, as I haven’t heard back from you regarding the carpet cleaning.

I completely understand if the original £230 quotation was more than you were looking to spend. That price was for my top-tier professional deep clean, but I can also offer a more affordable cleaning option if that would suit your budget better.

I also offer a like-for-like price-match service, so if you have received a lower quotation elsewhere for the same standard of work, please feel free to send it over and I’ll do my best to match it.

If you would like to see examples of my work and customer results, I’d be happy to send you a link to my Facebook page, where you can view plenty of before-and-after photos.

Please let me know if you’re still interested, and I’ll be happy to discuss the different options with you.

Kind regards,

Paul
The Carpet Cleaning Company

Hi [customer first name],

I hope you’re well. I just wanted to follow up, as I haven’t heard back from you regarding the carpet cleaning.

I completely understand if the original [their confirmed quotation] quotation was more than you were looking to spend. That price was for my top-tier professional deep clean, but I can also offer a more affordable cleaning option if that would suit your budget better.

I also offer a like-for-like price-match service, so if you have received a lower quotation elsewhere for the same standard of work, please feel free to send it over and I’ll do my best to match it.

If you would like to see examples of my work and customer results, I’d be happy to send you a link to my Facebook page, where you can view plenty of before-and-after photos.

The Carpet Cleaning Company
guidance: Use only for an unanswered sent quotation or an unbooked enquiry where follow-up is appropriate. Do not use for an unsent draft quote, a confirmed booking, an invoice reminder, a recent reply or a customer who declined further contact. Use the actual customer name and quote. Offer to discuss a more affordable scope, without inventing a lower price or implying the same service costs less. Only describe the original quote as top-tier if the customer record confirms it. Offer to review a like-for-like competing quotation and do the best to match, never guarantee a match. Offer Facebook examples; include a link only if verified in business settings. Keep SMS shorter. Do not automatically send or change the lead status.
